notes.title: Heart Keeper 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The new update is here, and there are the changes:

1. Settings have been fixed! They're now much clearer and more intuitive.
2. A new enemy, the Dragonfly, has been added! It spawns after wave 16.

Thank you for playing! If you enjoy the game, please don't forget to leave a [b]positive review[/b]. See you!

notes.title: Official statement regarding the difficulty of my game
notes.notes:
I understand that Heart Keeper can be tough at the beginning, especially at the beginning when it doesn't offer much guidance. However, I assure you that if you [b]keep playing and don't give up[/b], you will start to understand the game better and things will start to fall into place.

Each death is not a failure - it's a step closer to beating the 16th wave. Each attempt teaches you something new about the mechanics and strategies needed to succeed, and allows you to earn gold to buy permanent upgrades. Taking on these challenges is part of the game. I think the difficulty of Heart Keeper is also one of its important features. [b]See you in the game![/b]

Some important information that may help:
[list]
[*] Gold - the currency with which you can buy permanent upgrades - drops out of chests, and its amount is random and ranges from 50 to 200.
[*] Every second is extremely important, especially during the break, when you can gather resources.
[*] Upgrading is important, but before upgrading, it's a good idea to learn about the turret's strengths.
[*] Long-range turrets should be surrounded by short-range turrets.
[/list]

notes.title: Status Update 1
notes.notes:
[b]Good afternoon, everyone![/b]

The release date for Heart Keeper is getting closer, and as you may have noticed, today I finally revealed the release month! In this announcement, I would like to share with you some things I have done since the last update.

Here is what has changed since the last post:
[list]
[*]     A new score system based on how many waves the player has completed and the time taken.
[*]     Steamworks integration, including a working leaderboard based on the new score system.
[*]     Five new types of turrets, including a powerful rocket launcher (which I personally really like, heh).
[*]     Two new enemy types.
[*]     Two different endings for the game.
[/list]

There are still many things left to do, but I will do everything in my power to finish them before the beginning of [b]May[/b].
